name: Emotional / brand tone
controls: The feeling and personality the piece projects, independent of its visual style: how serious or light, warm or cool, loud or quiet, safe or daring it reads.
question: How should the video feel, and what personality should it have?
notes: Tone is separate from visual style: a flat minimal UI scene can read as trustworthy, playful or dramatic depending only on timing. The same card animated with 150 ms spring-overshoot entrances and 40 ms staggers feels playful; with 250 ms expo-out and no overshoot, confident and technical; with 1200 ms ease-in-out and 2 s holds, premium; with a 600 ms held breath then a 120 ms slam and impact sound, dramatic. Levers that shift tone without changing assets: duration (short = energetic, long = calm/premium), easing (overshoot and elastic = playful; expo/quart out = confident; sine in-out = soft; linear = mechanical/technical), stagger (tight = energetic, wide = deliberate), holds (long holds = gravity), amplitude (large scale and rotation = bold; small offsets of 8-24 px = refined), cut rhythm, and sound. Combine up to three tones, usually one primary and one or two modifiers (e.g. premium + calm, playful + friendly + energetic). Some pairs pull against each other (luxurious vs quirky, serious vs cute); combining them needs a deliberate reason. Tone words are informal and used loosely by clients; the prompts turn each into concrete timing, spacing, type and color decisions.

options.what: Weighty and restrained; no jokes, no flourish; the subject matters.
options.looks: Muted palette, strong contrast, generous margins, sans or serif text set plainly.
options.motion: Measured, linear-ish or gentle ease-out moves, no bounce, long holds.
options.use: Healthcare, security incidents, public sector, social causes, compliance.
options.vs: Professional is polished and neutral; serious adds weight and emotional restraint. Dramatic is heightened; serious is not.
options.prompt: Timing: moves 500-900 ms with gentle ease-out, no overshoot or bounce, holds >= 2 s. Spacing: wide margins, few elements. Type: plain sans or serif, regular to medium weight, sentence case. Color: muted, desaturated palette with one restrained accent; no bright gradients.

options.what: Competent, polished and neutral; the default for B2B.
options.looks: Clean grids, consistent spacing, brand-accurate color, clear hierarchy.
options.motion: Consistent 300-500 ms ease-out moves, modest stagger, clean transitions.
options.use: B2B SaaS, finance, consulting, enterprise product videos.
options.vs: Trustworthy emphasizes safety and honesty; professional emphasizes polish. Pushed too far it becomes generic 'corporate'.
options.prompt: Timing: 300-500 ms moves with power2/power3 ease-out, 60-100 ms staggers, 1.2-2 s holds. Spacing: strict 8 px grid, consistent margins. Type: one neo-grotesk sans, 2-3 weights, clear hierarchy. Color: brand primary plus neutrals; accent used only for emphasis.

options.what: Precise and systematic; speaks to experts with accurate detail.
options.looks: Monospace accents, grids, diagrams, code, measurements, dark UI.
options.motion: Linear or crisp expo moves, step-based reveals, typing and data ticks, exact alignments.
options.use: Developer tools, infrastructure, hardware specs, AI/ML products.
options.vs: Futuristic imagines what's next; technical shows how it works now. Intellectual is about ideas; technical is about mechanisms.
options.prompt: Timing: crisp 200-400 ms moves with expo.out, linear for data flow and scanning, step-based text reveals (typing at 30-60 chars/s). Spacing: visible grids, precise alignment. Type: grotesk sans with monospace for labels, numbers and code. Color: dark neutral ground, one signal color, syntax-style accents.

options.what: Stable and honest; nothing surprising, everything clear.
options.looks: Balanced layouts, blue/green or calm brand hues, real data, clear labels.
options.motion: Predictable, smooth, consistent moves; nothing jumps or flashes.
options.use: Fintech, insurance, healthcare, security, identity products.
options.vs: Professional is about polish; trustworthy is about predictability and honesty (real numbers, no hype).
options.prompt: Timing: steady 400-600 ms ease-in-out, identical transitions throughout, holds >= 1.5 s. Spacing: balanced, symmetric layouts. Type: humanist or neo-grotesk sans, medium weight, sentence case. Color: calm cool palette (blue, teal, green) with neutral grounds; show real, specific data rather than hype claims.

options.what: Approachable and warm; the product feels easy and kind.
options.looks: Rounded shapes and corners, warm colors, soft shadows, conversational copy.
options.motion: Soft springs with slight overshoot, gentle bounces on arrival, easy stagger.
options.use: Consumer apps, SMB tools, onboarding, community products.
options.vs: Playful is about fun and surprise; friendly is about warmth and ease. Human emphasizes people and imperfection.
options.prompt: Timing: 350-550 ms with soft spring or back.out(1.2) (overshoot <= 5%), 60-90 ms staggers. Spacing: generous padding, large corner radii (12-24 px). Type: rounded or humanist sans, medium weight, conversational sentence case. Color: warm, light palette with soft tints.

options.what: Centered on people and real moments; imperfect, warm and genuine.
options.looks: Real photography or footage of people, handwritten or organic touches, candid framing.
options.motion: Organic, slightly irregular timing; handheld-feel camera; natural pacing.
options.use: Customer stories, recruiting, community, healthcare, nonprofits.
options.vs: Friendly can be fully synthetic (UI, shapes); human requires people or human traces (hands, voices, handwriting).
options.prompt: Timing: natural, slightly varied durations (+/- 10-20% between similar moves), soft ease-in-out, subtle handheld drift on the camera. Spacing: relaxed, editorial. Type: humanist sans or serif, possibly handwritten accents. Color: natural, warm grade; skin tones protected.

options.what: Fun and energetic, with surprises and physical humor in the motion.
options.looks: Bright colors, chunky shapes, characters or stickers, big rounded type.
options.motion: Springs with overshoot, squash and stretch, bounces, pops, wiggles, unexpected transitions.
options.use: Consumer apps, games, kids and education, social content.
options.vs: Quirky is odd and idiosyncratic; playful is broadly fun. Cute adds softness and small scale.
options.prompt: Timing: 250-450 ms with elastic or back.out(1.7) overshoot, squash and stretch on landings (scale 0.9/1.1), 40-70 ms staggers, occasional wiggle or pop. Spacing: loose, asymmetric. Type: rounded or chunky display sans, heavy weight. Color: saturated brights, 3-5 hues.

options.what: Idiosyncratic and unexpected; deliberate oddness that feels distinctive.
options.looks: Unusual color pairings, odd crops, collage, unexpected characters or objects.
options.motion: Irregular timing, surprising transformations, deadpan holds, stepped or off-beat movement.
options.use: Challenger brands, creative tools, culture, social campaigns.
options.vs: Playful is fun in expected ways; quirky is fun in unexpected ways. Experimental aims at novelty; quirky aims at charm.
options.prompt: Timing: mix unexpected rhythms (a slow move followed by an instant jump), deadpan holds of 1-2 s, occasional stepped motion at 12 fps. Spacing: off-grid placements, odd crops. Type: unusual display face or mixed faces. Color: unexpected pairings (e.g. mustard + lilac + tomato).

options.what: Soft, small, round and endearing.
options.looks: Rounded blobs, big-eyed characters, pastel colors, soft shadows.
options.motion: Squishy springs, small bounces, jelly wobbles, blinking and breathing idles.
options.use: Consumer apps, mascots, stickers, kids' products.
options.vs: Playful can be loud and bold; cute is soft and small. Friendly doesn't require characters.
options.prompt: Timing: 300-500 ms squishy springs with jelly wobble on settle (scale 1.05 -> 0.97 -> 1), small bounces, 3-4 s idle breathing cycles. Spacing: compact, clustered. Type: rounded, heavy, lowercase-friendly. Color: pastels, soft pinks, mint, butter yellow.

options.what: Trend-aware, fast and expressive; native to social platforms.
options.looks: Bold type, stickers, emoji, collage, high-saturation or acid palettes, meme formats.
options.motion: Fast cuts, zoom punches, kinetic captions, jump cuts, stop-motion textures.
options.use: Consumer social apps, fashion, music, student products.
options.vs: Energetic is about speed; youthful is about cultural codes. Ages fast: trends date quickly.
options.prompt: Timing: 150-300 ms moves, zoom punches (scale to 110-120% in 100 ms), cuts every 0.8-1.5 s, captions word by word. Spacing: layered, overlapping, sticker-like placements. Type: heavy display sans or expressive mixed type. Color: high saturation, acid or neon accents.

options.what: Fast, forceful and kinetic; constant forward momentum.
options.looks: Diagonals, big type, motion blur, bright accents.
options.motion: Short durations, strong ease-outs, motion blur, fast cuts, impacts on beats.
options.use: Launch trailers, sports, event openers, social ads.
options.vs: Bold is about scale and contrast; energetic is about speed. Dramatic uses contrast in time (build and release); energetic keeps intensity high.
options.prompt: Timing: 150-350 ms with expo.out, motion blur on fast moves, cuts every 0.8-1.5 s on beats, 20-40 ms staggers. Spacing: tight, diagonal compositions. Type: heavy or condensed sans, large. Color: high-contrast with one hot accent.

options.what: Big, high-contrast and assertive; takes up space.
options.looks: Oversized type, full-bleed color fields, heavy weights, strong contrast.
options.motion: Large-amplitude moves, full-frame wipes, slams, decisive cuts.
options.use: Campaigns, launches, challenger brands, social.
options.vs: Confident is assured but can be quiet; bold is loud. Energetic is about speed; bold is about scale.
options.prompt: Timing: 250-450 ms decisive moves, full-frame wipes and color floods, slams with 1-2 frame impact holds. Spacing: fill the frame; type bleeding off edges allowed. Type: heavy or black weight, 15-30% of frame height. Color: 2-3 flat high-contrast colors.

options.what: Rule-breaking, raw and confrontational.
options.looks: Distressed textures, photocopy, torn paper, clashing type, handmade marks.
options.motion: Jittery, stop-motion, glitches, abrupt cuts, deliberate imperfections.
options.use: Streetwear, music, challenger brands, activism.
options.vs: Experimental explores; rebellious confronts. Bold can be clean; rebellious is rough.
options.prompt: Timing: stepped 8-12 fps motion, abrupt hard cuts, jitter (1-3 px per frame) on type, glitch frames. Spacing: off-grid, overlapping, cropped. Type: clashing faces, distressed or handwritten. Color: black, white, one aggressive accent (red, safety orange); photocopy texture.

options.what: Novel and exploratory; form comes first and conventions are optional.
options.looks: Unusual techniques, generative forms, unconventional layouts, abstract imagery.
options.motion: Unexpected timing, generative behavior, non-standard transitions.
options.use: Creative tools, art direction showcases, festivals, fashion.
options.vs: Quirky aims at charm; experimental aims at novelty. Futuristic can be conventional in structure.
options.prompt: Timing: break conventions deliberately (irregular durations, reversed or time-remapped motion, long unexplained holds). Spacing: unconventional layouts, extreme scale contrasts. Type: variable fonts distorted over time or unusual faces. Color: unexpected, limited palette. State the one rule the piece breaks and keep breaking it consistently.

options.what: Idea-led and considered; rewards attention.
options.looks: Serif or refined type, diagrams, references, restrained palettes, lots of text space.
options.motion: Measured reveals, diagrams building, calm transitions.
options.use: Research, publishing, think tanks, AI research labs, education.
options.vs: Editorial is about layout and publishing codes; intellectual is about substance. Technical is about mechanisms.
options.prompt: Timing: 500-900 ms ease-in-out, reveals paced to reading (>= 250 ms per word held), holds >= 2 s. Spacing: wide margins, asymmetrical editorial grid. Type: serif for statements, small sans for labels. Color: off-white or deep neutral ground, one muted accent.

options.what: Borrows the codes of print publishing: grids, typographic hierarchy, image-text interplay.
options.looks: Large serif headlines, columns, captions, pull quotes, crisp photography, rules.
options.motion: Clean masks and wipes, type sliding within columns, page-turn logic, precise holds.
options.use: Brand films, fashion, publishing, premium SaaS.
options.vs: Intellectual is a mood; editorial is a set of layout conventions. Minimal can lack the typographic hierarchy editorial depends on.
options.prompt: Timing: 400-700 ms masked reveals with power3.out, line-by-line headline reveals staggered 80-120 ms. Spacing: strict column grid, generous gutters, hairline rules. Type: high-contrast serif display with small sans captions. Color: paper white or black with one accent; photography as color source.

options.what: Refined and considered; signals quality without shouting.
options.looks: Restrained palette, precise type, fine details, careful lighting, space.
options.motion: Smooth, slower moves, small amplitudes, perfect settles, no gimmicks.
options.use: Flagship products, pro tiers, premium SaaS, consumer hardware.
options.vs: Luxurious goes further into opulence and exclusivity; premium is refined but accessible. Minimal is a style; premium is a perceived value.
options.prompt: Timing: 700-1200 ms with expo or quart out, no overshoot, small movement amplitudes (8-24 px), holds >= 2 s. Spacing: generous negative space, precise alignment. Type: refined sans or serif, light-to-medium weights, slight positive tracking on caps. Color: deep neutrals, one metallic or muted accent.

options.what: Opulent and exclusive; slow, sensual and rich in material.
options.looks: Black or rich dark grounds, gold or jewel tones, macro material detail, elegant serifs.
options.motion: Very slow reveals, light sweeps across surfaces, slow orbits, silky moves.
options.use: Luxury goods, fashion, hospitality, fragrance, automotive.
options.vs: Premium is refined; luxurious is indulgent. Slow pacing alone doesn't make it luxurious without material richness.
options.prompt: Timing: 1200-2500 ms moves with long ease-out, light sweeps across surfaces over 1.5-2 s, slow orbits (<= 15 degrees over a shot), holds >= 3 s. Spacing: vast negative space, one object per frame. Type: high-contrast serif or refined wide caps with wide tracking (+100-200). Color: black, ivory, gold or jewel tones.

options.what: Unhurried and quiet; lowers the viewer's heart rate.
options.looks: Soft palettes, open space, gentle gradients, few elements.
options.motion: Slow ease-in-out, gentle drifts, crossfades, breathing loops.
options.use: Wellness, productivity, finance for consumers, ambient.
options.vs: Soft is about texture and softness of form; calm is about tempo. Minimal is a style that can be fast.
options.prompt: Timing: 800-1500 ms sine in-out, crossfades >= 600 ms, holds >= 2.5 s, no cut faster than 3 s. Spacing: open, centered compositions. Type: light or regular weight sans, sentence case. Color: low-contrast soft palette (sage, sand, sky), gentle gradients.

options.what: Gentle forms and transitions: blurred, rounded, low contrast.
options.looks: Blur, soft gradients, rounded shapes, pastel or muted colors, diffuse shadows.
options.motion: Blur transitions, gentle scale, slow fades, no hard edges in time or space.
options.use: Beauty, wellness, consumer lifestyle, onboarding.
options.vs: Calm is tempo; soft is texture and edge. Cute adds characters and bounce.
options.prompt: Timing: 600-1000 ms sine in-out, blur-to-sharp transitions (8-0 px), crossfades rather than cuts. Spacing: airy. Type: light weights, rounded or humanist sans. Color: pastels or muted tones, diffuse shadows (large blur, 5-10% opacity), no pure black.

options.what: Reduced to essentials; every element and every motion justified.
options.looks: Few elements, strict grid, limited palette, lots of negative space.
options.motion: One motion at a time, small economical moves, clean cuts or simple fades.
options.use: Tech, design tools, premium brands, typographic pieces.
options.vs: Minimal is a tonal restraint here; the visual-style dimension covers minimalism as an aesthetic. Premium implies value; minimal implies reduction.
options.prompt: Timing: one thing moves at a time, 300-600 ms ease-out, holds >= 1.5 s. Spacing: >= 50% negative space. Type: one sans family, two weights max. Color: monochrome or neutral plus one accent. Remove any element or motion that doesn't carry information.

options.what: Assured and decisive, without needing to shout.
options.looks: Clear hierarchy, large headlines, precise alignment, restrained palette.
options.motion: Decisive expo-out moves that settle firmly, no hesitation or wobble, deliberate holds.
options.use: Launch films, category leaders, premium SaaS.
options.vs: Bold is loud; confident can be quiet. Professional is safe; confident takes a clear position.
options.prompt: Timing: 300-500 ms expo.out or power4.out moves that stop firmly (no overshoot, no wobble), holds >= 1.5 s, no filler motion during holds. Spacing: clean, deliberate alignment. Type: large, medium-to-bold sans headlines, short declarative lines. Color: restrained, high contrast.

options.what: Evokes the future: advanced technology, space, AI.
options.looks: Dark grounds, glows, gradients, holographic or glass materials, fine grids, particles.
options.motion: Smooth floating motion, scanning lines, particle flows, light trails, HUD elements.
options.use: AI products, hardware, automotive, space, crypto.
options.vs: Technical is accurate about now; futuristic is speculative. Can become cliché (blue glow, HUDs) if overused.
options.prompt: Timing: smooth 600-1000 ms power2 in-out, continuous slow float (2-4 px, 4 s cycles), scanning and particle flows at constant speed. Spacing: centered, symmetric. Type: wide or geometric sans, uppercase labels with wide tracking. Color: dark ground, one luminous accent with glow (avoid defaulting to cyan).

options.what: Recalls an earlier era through period codes of color, texture and technique.
options.looks: Film grain, faded palettes, period typography, VHS or print artifacts.
options.motion: Period-appropriate timing: stepped animation, film gate weave, VHS tracking, cel-like holds.
options.use: Anniversaries, consumer brands, music, fashion, heritage.
options.vs: Nostalgic is the feeling; the era dimension names the specific period (70s, Y2K, etc.).
options.prompt: Timing: stepped motion at 12 fps or film gate weave (0.5-1 px jitter), slower cel-like holds. Spacing: period layout conventions. Type: period-appropriate faces. Color: faded, warm-shifted palette with lifted blacks; add grain (3-6% opacity) or VHS artifacts matching the chosen era.

options.what: Withholds and obscures; creates intrigue.
options.looks: Low-key lighting, shadows, fog, partial views, silhouettes, minimal type.
options.motion: Slow reveals, drifting fog, light glints, slow push-ins, withheld cuts.
options.use: Teasers, pre-launch, entertainment, fragrance.
options.vs: Dramatic resolves tension loudly; mysterious sustains it. Cinematic is a production quality; mysterious is a mood.
options.prompt: Timing: deliberate push-ins that land (4-8% scale per second, never a slow creep), reveals of 1.5-3 s, long silences, occasional 1-3 frame glints. Spacing: most of the frame in shadow; subject partially cropped. Type: small, widely tracked, sparse. Color: near-black low-key palette with one cold or warm light source.

options.what: Borrows the grammar of film: framing, lighting, camera, grade and score.
options.looks: Widescreen framing (2.39:1 letterbox optional), depth of field, graded color, atmosphere.
options.motion: Motivated camera moves (dolly, crane, rack focus), shot-reverse-shot logic, score-driven pacing.
options.use: Brand films, launch films, trailers, hardware reveals.
options.vs: Dramatic is heightened emotion; cinematic is a filmmaking vocabulary that can be quiet. Often used loosely to mean 'expensive'.
options.prompt: Timing: shots 2-5 s with motivated camera moves (slow dolly-in, crane, rack focus over 600-1000 ms), cuts on action or score. Spacing: widescreen compositions using rule of thirds and depth layers. Type: refined, sparse, titles held >= 2.5 s. Color: graded look (e.g. teal-orange or warm filmic), vignette, subtle grain and depth of field.

options.what: Heightened emotion through contrast: silence and impact, dark and light, slow and fast.
options.looks: High contrast, deep shadows, big type, spotlight lighting.
options.motion: Build-ups and slams, speed ramps, held breaths before reveals, impacts with shake.
options.use: Trailers, event openers, reveals, sports.
options.vs: Energetic keeps intensity constant; dramatic uses contrast between quiet and loud. Cinematic is a vocabulary; dramatic is intensity.
options.prompt: Timing: alternate long quiet builds (slow 2-4 s pushes) with sudden 100-200 ms slams; insert a 400-800 ms held breath before each reveal; speed ramps into impacts; 2-4 frame camera shake on hits. Spacing: centered, monumental. Type: heavy or condensed, very large. Color: high-contrast, deep blacks, one hot light.

options.what: Forward-looking and uplifting; things are getting better.
options.looks: Light, bright palettes, upward compositions, open skies or open space, smiling people.
options.motion: Upward and forward movement, rising curves, gentle acceleration into reveals.
options.use: Vision films, climate and health, consumer launches, nonprofits.
options.vs: Friendly is about warmth in the moment; optimistic is about the future. Energetic can be aggressive; optimistic is buoyant.
options.prompt: Timing: 400-700 ms ease-out, with rising motion (elements enter from below or travel upward) and a gradual brightening across the piece. Spacing: open, upward-weighted compositions. Type: regular to medium sans, sentence case. Color: bright, warm-light palette that brightens toward the end.

options.what: Pressing and immediate; demands attention now.
options.looks: Signal colors (red, amber), countdowns, bold alerts, tight crops.
options.motion: Fast cuts, pulsing indicators, ticking timers, no lingering.
options.use: Sales and offers, security alerts, breaking news, deadlines.
options.vs: Energetic is excitement; urgent is pressure. Overuse reads as alarmist.
options.prompt: Timing: 150-300 ms moves, 1 s pulse cycles on alert elements, ticking counters, cuts every 1 s. Spacing: tight crops, centered alerts. Type: heavy condensed sans, uppercase for alerts. Color: signal red or amber against neutral dark or white; everything else muted.
